component.name: TrickLogic2
component.summary: Trick x Logic Season 2, played from your own disc

description.p: A native port of the PSP mystery novel game Trick x Logic Season 2. It contains none of the game's data: setup prepares the game from an image of your own disc, the Japanese release or its Simplified Chinese translation, as an .iso or a CHD.
Season 1's four cases can be added from an image of your Season 1 disc, and join Season 2's shelf.
